༄༅/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bla brgyud ni/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bla brgyud ni/

rigs kun khyab bdag 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro la yī ta badzra/ /don yod rdo rje ye shes 'byung gnas sbas/ /padma badzra zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dhi paṃ ka ra rwa lo rdo rje grags/ /chos rab ye shes seng ge 'bum seng zhabs/ /rje btsun rga lo sher seng ye shes dpal/ /don grub rin po che la= rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /de sras thu bo dge legs dpal bzang nas/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin rnams la= de ltar gsol ba btab pas 'gro ba kun/ / 'jam dpal zhi khros 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal gyur te/ /zung 'jug go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig /smon lam ni/ de ltar 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i bsgom bzlas la/ /gcig tu brtson pa'i rnam dkar dge des bdag /thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud smin te/ /zab mo'i lam gyis grol bar byed nus shog /rnam dag dbang bzhis dri ma kun sbyangs te/ /sku bzhi 'grub pa'i nus pa 'jog pa dang*/ /de tshe khas blangs dam tshig sdom pa rnams/ /srog bsngos tshul bzhin srung bar byed gyur cig /zhing gi dam par bsod nams tshogs nyid dang*/ /sngags gnyis don bsgoms ye shes tshogs bsags nas/ /ma dag 'chi ba'i skyon sbyangs lam 'bras kyi/ /chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba nyid gyur cig /drag pa'i 'khor lo la gnas khro bcu yis/ /nag po'i rtsa lag dpung bcas tshar bcad de/ /ye shes rang bzhin gzhal yas khang bsgoms pas/ /rgyal ba'i zhing bzang myur du 'grub par shog /chu shel lte bar dhīḥyig ral gri dang*/ /de las 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid bsgoms byas pas/ /bar do'i skyon sbyangs rgyal ba'i longs sku mchog /'grub pa'i dge rtsa yongs su smin par shog /tsha zer rgyas pa'i lte bar hūṃ yig dang*/ khro bo'i rdo rje las grub 'jigs byed sku/ /zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor

gyis/ /skye ba'i skyon sbyangs sprul sku 'grub par shog /sdud rim nyid dang sngags kyi rnal 'byor mchog /bsgoms pas kun rtog g.yo ba'i las rlung rnams/ /dhū tīri thim las stong pa rnam gsum dang*/ /dpe yi 'od gsal mthar thug 'char bar shog /de nas chu las chu bur brdol ba ltar/ /dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa/ /'od gsal nyid du yang yang zhugs pa las/ /don gyi lhan skyes mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de las slob pa'i zung 'jug 'grub gyur nas/ /spyod pa rnam gsum goms pa byas pa'i mthar/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin de nyid kyis/ /mi slob zung 'jug go 'phang thob gyur cig /go 'phang mchog de mngon du gyur pa na/ /grangs med sprul pa phyogs bcur rab spros te/ /mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'jam dpal zhi khro yi/ /go 'phang mchog la bde blag 'god par shog /shis brjod ni/ rab yangs nam mkhar gshin rje gshed po yi/ /lha tshogs me tog char 'bebs shis pa brjod/ /bgegs 'joms phun tshogs dpal ster shes kyis dang*/ /bkra shis gdangs snyan bdag gis bsgrag par bya/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /drag po'i skur bstan 'jigs mdzad gshin rje gshed/ /la lī ta sogs bla ma brgyud pa la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis dang*/ /mi mthun kun zhi mthun rkyen 'grub pa sogs/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas kun dngos 'jam dpal dpa' bo dang*/ /mgon de'i lung dang rtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos/ /de nyid phyogs gcig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun la/ /legs tshogs= mi mthun kun zhi= phun tshogs= rnam mang rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing*/ / rnam snang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rnam dag ye shes gzhal yas khang chen la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis dang*/ /ma dag snod kyi dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /dag pa'i zhing du rol pa'i bkra shig shog

/ces 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa mdor bsdus pa 'di yang*/ dad dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba'i gnas brtan rgyal mtshan bkra shis zhes bgyi bas bskul ba ltar/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bla brgyud bzhugs/ -PAGE 82--PAGE 83--PAGE 81-
